contentList.content: You gain <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock Spell Slots</LSTag>, which are restored upon taking a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag> and allow you to cast Spells at the highest level possible.
Pacts can forge a Warlock's soul to a creature, object, or concept. Who or what have you signed your soul to?
Pledge yourself to an ancient fey spirit, and the sumptuous and scary qualities of their extraordinary realm.
Pledge your soul to the Hells and their deadly arsenal of fiendish arcana.
Pledge your soul to something unthinkable - an unspeakably ancient entity of entropy and control.
Pledge your soul to the Shadowfell - a force that manifests within sentient darkness.
Conjure a beam of crackling energy.

You are privy to the indescribable horrors of the universe, and as such, are able to channel an inkling of their influence. You gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of the Blade, you wreathe your equipped weapon in Hellfire for three turns.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of the Chained, you recover one charge of your Chained Bonds.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of Penumbra, you extend your state of Penumbral Light or Penumbral Darkness out to three turns.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of the Tome, the number you need in order to roll a Critical Hit on your next Eldritch Blast is reduced by 1.

Affected creature has reduced the number they need in order to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> by 1 on their next cast of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of the Primordial, you will immediately shift into your Demonic Visage.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> Bargaining your life in this way renders your maximum Hit Points lowered until your next <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag> or until you have died.

Affected creature's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by 10% per stack of Hematic Invocation.

Upon reaching ten stacks, they will immediately die.

Sacrifice 10% of your total Hit Points to an Eldritch abomination in order to restore a Warlock Spell Slot.

While abiding by the Pact of Severance, you cross the line between life and death, and Sever yourself.
At the beginning of any combat encounter, restore one <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock Spell Slot</LSTag>.
When dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you deal an additional +1d12 damage.
When dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you deal an additional +1d12 damage. This can be toggled at any time.
At the beginning of any combat encounter, restore two <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock Spell Slots</LSTag>.
When dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you deal an additional +2d12 damage.
When dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you deal an additional +2d12 damage. This can be toggled at any time.

Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against the Warlock who applied this condition until the start of their next turn.

Your Pact manifests as raw power in way of a weapon of choice, bound to your very being.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Tank

Gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_PactOfTheBlade_Bind">Bind</LSTag> your equipped weapon, wreathing it in hellfire when using it to kill other creatures or land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

Your melee or ranged weapons become magical, utilizing your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit with your Pact Weapon, the weapon become wreathed in flame for three turns.

Your melee weapons become magical, utilizing your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit with your Pact Weapon, the weapon become wreathed in flame for three turns.

Your ranged weapons become magical, utilizing your Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit with your Pact Weapon, the weapon become wreathed in flame for three turns.

Affected weapon has become magical, utilizing its owners Spellcasting Ability for Attack Rolls and damage.

Upon killing another creature or landing a Critical Hit, this weapon will become wreathed in flame for three turns.
Affected creature's weapons have become wreathed in flame, and now deals additional damage.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, your patron will grant you <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">Temporary Hit Points</LSTag> equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Charisma Modifier</LSTag> added to your level. In addition, each killing blow has a 25% chance to remove one stack of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.
Teleport to an area of your choice, scorching all nearby creatures.

When dealing damage to an enemy, you ignore all forms of Fire <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag>. In addition, while your weapons are coated in <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HELLFIRE">Hellfire</LSTag>, dealing damage with your main-hand weapon causes all targets within [1] of you to take Fire damage equal to your levels in Warlock.

Casting <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_HellbladeResonation">Hellblade Resonation</LSTag> now causes enemies to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burn</LSTag> for one turn. When dealing damage to a Burning creature, you roll your damage dice with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Every three turns, you erupt in an Eldritch Inferno, dealing [1] to all enemies within [2]. Landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> reduces the time it takes to erupt by one turn.
Affected creature will erupt in an Eldritch Inferno upon the expiration of this condition, dealing [1] to all enemies within [2].

Chained to something unknowable and fierce, your power now lies within your ability to summon and control hellish minions, from imps to undead dragons.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Summoner

Utilized to summon <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PactOfTheChain_Container">Chained Companions</LSTag>. Using <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation">Hematic Invocation</LSTag> will also restore one charge.
Affected creature is benefiting from one or more passives provided by its summoning Warlock.
Affected creature will die at the end of the current combat encounter.

A binding pact links you and your Chained Companions, preventing your Eldritch Blast from harming them. Their stats increase for each of your Warlock levels.

Upon landing a killing blow, your Chained Companions have a 25% chance to remove one stack of your Hematic Invocation.

Summon a familiar, bound and chained to your will. Your familiars grow in strength alongside you as you level within the Pact of the Chained.

You may have up to three Chained Companions at any given time.

Affected creature has Chained Companions currently summoned equal to the duration of this condition.

They may have up to three Chained Companions at any given time.
Summon a familiar with the form of an Imp. Lesser Chained Companions are considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUMMONING_SICKNESS">Horde-Based</LSTag> summons.
Summon a familiar with the form of a Quasit.
Summon a cheeky familiar with the form of a foul-mouthed Quasit. Lesser Chained Companions are considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUMMONING_SICKNESS">Horde-Based</LSTag> summons.
Summon a familiar with the form of a Hellboar. Lesser Chained Companions are considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SUMMONING_SICKNESS">Horde-Based</LSTag> summons.
Summon a familiar with the form of a Cambion.
Summon a familiar with the form of a Azer.
Summon a familiar with the form of a Succubus.
You may only have one Superior Chained Companion summoned at a time.

Summon a familiar with the form of a Orthon.

The power required to maintain such a creature is overwhelmingly intense. As such, this creature will only persist until the end of combat.

Summon a familiar with the form of a Spectator.

The power required to maintain such a creature is overwhelmingly intense. As such, this creature will only persist until the end of combat.
Shoot an eye ray that puts its target to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SLEEP">Sleep</LSTag>.

Summon a familiar with the form of an Undead Wyrmling.

The power required to maintain such a creature is overwhelmingly intense. As such, this creature will only persist until the end of combat.
Instil <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FEARED">Terror</LSTag> in nearby foes.
Affected creature is gathering energy while airborne and is <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to all damage.
Hurl a tiny spark of fire.
Magically bolstered due to the nature of the pact this familiar's Warlock made, this Spell does not require a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>, but may only be cast once per combat.

Gain the ability to summon <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PactOfTheChain_Container">Chained Companions</LSTag>, Fiends and Abberations empowered by your Eldritch abilities and bound to your command. Chained Companions grow in strength alongside you. As your power grows, you will bind even more fearsome creatures to your will.
As your pact deepens, so too does the strength of your familiars. Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PactOfTheChain_Container">Chained Companions</LSTag> have learned new abilities.

Your Chained Companions roll an additional damage die when attacking with their Cantrip. Additionally, they have gained an Extra Action. Upon each instance of damage, your Chained Companions will now inflict Eldritch Inertia.

In addition, you gain the ability to summon an Azer, a Cambion, and a Succubus.
When dealing damage, you apply <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ELDRITCH_STRIKE">Eldritch Inertia</LSTag>.

The strength of your pact has grown more potent, giving way to Eldritch power. Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PactOfTheChain_Container">Chained Companions</LSTag> have gained even more abilities.

Your Chained Companions roll two additional damage die when attacking with their Cantrip. Additionally, they have gained Improved Extra Actions. Upon each instance of damage, your summons will now inflict Eldritch Inertia and a Curse of Hellfire.

In addition, you gain the ability to summon an Orthon, a Spectator, and an Undead Dragon.

When dealing damage, you apply one <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CURSEOFHELLFIRE">Curse of Hellfire</LSTag> stack to your target. Both yourself and your summoning Warlock then make further <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against the target.

The blood that binds you to your pact has become utterly resolute. Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_PactOfTheChain_Container">Chained Companions</LSTag> have reached the peak of their potential.

You've bound your soul to something eldritch and ancient for powers obscure. Within the corners of your mind, you feel it clawing, begging to be let out. And thus begins your journey to feed it...

Suggested Role(s): Damage
Each turn while in combat you have a 33% chance to shift into a state of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEMONIC_VISAGE">Demonic Visage</LSTag> for one turn.

Affected creature is channeling demonic energy from a primordial place unknown. They roll their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and Damage Rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>, and may cast Spells without expending <LSTag Tooltip="WarlockSpellSlot">Warlock Spell Slots</LSTag>. However all Spells cast will accrue one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEMATICINVOCATION">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to absorb the life force from a humanoid corpse within [1] of you, immediately removing one stack of Hematic Invocation.

This action cannot be used while under the influence of your Demonic Visage.

Absorb the life force from a corpse within [1] of you, immediately removing one stack of Hematic Invocation.

This action cannot be used while under the influence of your Demonic Visage.

Casting Advocatus Diaboli on a corpse when you have no stacks of Hematic Invocation will yield one Collected Soul.

Collected Souls may then be expended in place of your health when casting your Hematic Invocation or while in a state of Demonic Visage. This may be toggled at any time.

You may carry up to seven Collected Souls at any given time. All Collected Souls are lost upon the end of combat.

Souls collected from corpses along the way. May be expended in place of your health when casting your Hematic Invocation...or perhaps for something far more sinister.

You may only carry up to seven Collected Souls at any given time. All Collected Souls are lost upon the end of combat.

Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation_Primordial">Hematic Invocation</LSTag> now targets enemies within [1] of you, dealing [2]. Killing a creature in this way immediately removes one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEMATICINVOCATION">Hematic Invocation</LSTag> and grants a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="CollectedSoul">Collected Soul</LSTag> for later use.

Upon killing another creature with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation_Primordial">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>, the duration of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEMONIC_VISAGE">Demonic Visage</LSTag> is increased to three turns and you gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURROGATE_SLAUGHTER">Surrogate Slaughter</LSTag>.

Affected creature deals an additional [1] to all non-allied targets. In addition, they have greatly increased in both size and musculature, improving all of their physical capabilities and causing them to, if damaging a non-allied target, deal an additional [2] damage with their main-hand <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attacks</LSTag> and while unarmed.

Once per combat, and while in a state of both <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEMONIC_VISAGE">Demonic Visage</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURROGATE_SLAUGHTER">Surrogate Slaughter</LSTag>, you may utilize all seven of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="CollectedSoul">Collected Souls</LSTag> in order to shape into a Primordial Demon for one turn. While assuming the shape of a Primordial Demon, you may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Multiattack_Demon">Hellrake Defilement</LSTag>.

While in a state of both <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEMONIC_VISAGE">Demonic Visage</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURROGATE_SLAUGHTER">Surrogate Slaughter</LSTag>, utilize all seven of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="CollectedSoul">Collected Souls</LSTag> in order to shape into a Primordial Demon, capable of dealing enormous damage for one turn.
Affected creature has sacrificed seven souls in order to assume the shape of a Primordial Demon.
Utterly savage a creature of your choice.
Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see, scorching everything nearby.

You've pledged yourself to a maddened celestial to borrow their chaotic power. Bound to the concept itself, a penumbral blend of light and dark working as an affront in tandem.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Healer

Each turn in combat, you sway between states of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PENUMBRA_LIGHT">Penumbral Light</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PENUMBRA_DARK">Penumbral Darkness</LSTag>. Each state has unique benefits which improve as you level. Casting Hematic Invocation sets the duration of either state to three turns.

Affected creature has snuffed out the light from their surroundings, and their <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> deals Necrotic damage. When dealing damage to a non-allied target, they deal an additional [1].

Affected creature is shedding light in a [1] radius, and their <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> deals Radiant damage. When healing another creature, they recover an additional +1d4 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.
Conjure a beam of either necrotic or radiant energy.
Conjure a beam of necrotic energy.
Conjure a beam of radiant energy.
Cause your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> to deal Necrotic damage. When dealing damage, deal an additional [1].

Shed light in a [1] radius, causing your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> to deal Radiant damage. When healing another creature, they recover an additional +1d4 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.

While in combat under the affects of Penumbral Darkness, targeting a corpse with your Penumbral Eldritch Blast will create a Horde-Based Spectre until the end of combat. Upon dealing damage, your Spectres have a 25% chance to remove one stack of your Hematic Invocation. The strength of the spectre depends on the size of the enemy targeted.

In addition, while in combat under the affects of Penumbral Light, you may target your teammates with Penumbral Eldritch Blast in order to heal them, rather than dealing damage, and upon healing another creature, you will potentially remove a stack of Hematic Invocation. Effects which increase the damage you deal will not increase the amount of Hit Points you restore.

Your Penumbral Eldritch Blast now chains itself to an additional creature within [1] of your original target.

Projectiles created will chain differently depending on your initial target.

While starting your turn under the affects of Penumbral Darkness, you gain Greater Invisibility for one turn.

While starting your turn under the effects of Penumbral Light, you instead gain Dispel Evil and Good for one turn.
Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag> can now chain itself to up to two additional creatures, rather than one.

Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> will now turn enemies into <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ELDRITCH_BOMB">Eldritch Bombs</LSTag>. At the end of three turns, an afflicted enemy, and all enemies within [1] of them, will take either [2] or [3], depending on which Penumbral Eldritch Blast was used to apply the condition. Eldritch Bombs are further modified by effects which would alter your Eldritch Blast and may be immediately detonated by casting <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation_Penumbra">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.
Affected creature, and all other creatures within [1], will take [2] once this condition has expired.
Affected creature, and all other creatures within [1], will take massive damage once this condition has expired.

Infuse the target of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast_Penumbral_Container">Penumbral Eldritch Blast</LSTag> with an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ELDRITCH_BOMB">Eldritch Bomb</LSTag>. Eldritch Bombs can be immediately detonated by casting <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.

You have bargained with forces that dwell beyond the veil. By surrendering flesh and certainty alike, you walk the boundary between life and death.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage
When dealing damage to a non-allied target, you deal additional Cold damage equal to your levels in Warlock. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.
Conjure a beam of frigid energy. Upon dealing damage with this action, your targets receive one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted With Frost</LSTag>.

Conjure a beam of frigid energy, dealing damage across a [1] area. Upon dealing damage with this action, your targets receive one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted With Frost</LSTag>.

Affected creature is walking the line between life and death. They will not provoke <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag>, are permeable, and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> made against them are rolled with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>. In addition, they may move to a space of their choosing within [1] and can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fly">Fly</LSTag>.
Teleport to a space of your choosing within [1]. Your range is not limited by sight.

Dealing Cold damage to an enemy applies one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FROST">Encrusted With Frost</LSTag>. Killing a creature who is Encrusted With Frost has a 25% chance to remove one stack of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.

Upon using <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation_Severing">Severing Hematic Invocation</LSTag>, you restore your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>. In addition, your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SeveringEldritchBlast">Severing Eldritch Blast</LSTag> now deals damage in a [1] area of effect.
Dealing Cold damage to an enemy will apply one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FROSTBITE">Frigidity</LSTag>.

Upon being killed while in combat, you instead survive with one <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Point</LSTag>, and receive one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEMATICINVOCATION">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.

Affected creature will survive with one <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Point</LSTag> if killed during combat. Upon reviving, they will receive one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HEMATICINVOCATION">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.
Upon using <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation_Severing">Severing Hematic Invocation</LSTag>, your next instance of damage against an enemy will deal the maximum damage possible.
Affected creature's next instance of damage against an enemy will deal the maximum damage possible.

Erratic, eldritch power swirls within the palm of your hands, echoing out into an uncaring void, blast, after blast, after blast...

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Erratic, eldritch power swirls within the palm of your hands, echoing out into an uncaring void, blast, after blast, after blast...

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Erratic, eldritch power swirls within the palm of your hands, echoing out into an uncaring void, blast, after blast, after blast...

Suggested Role(s): Damage

You add your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Charisma Modifier</LSTag> to the damage your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag> deals, if positive and damaging a non-allied target. In addition, you are able to cast your Eldritch Blast with your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>. This can be toggled at any time.

Upon dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you apply <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ELDRITCH_STRIKE">Eldritch Inertia</LSTag>. In addition, killing a creature with your Eldritch Blast has a 25% chance to remove one stack of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HematicInvocation">Hematic Invocation</LSTag>.

You are capable of dividing your Eldritch Blast into two separate beams. Each beam will deal 2d12 Force damage. This can be toggled at any time.

In addition, you gain Eldritch Lance.

Fire a concentrated variant of your Eldritch Blast, which pierces enemies.

Most passives which modify your Eldritch Blast also modify your Eldritch Lance.
When you cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, the number you need in order to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> is reduced by 2.

You are capable of dividing your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag> into three separate beams. Each beam will deal 2d12 Force damage. This can be toggled at any time.
When you roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you roll two additional damage die.

Pacts forged in deepest secrecies beget chaotic, eldritch power.
Contracts satiated will provide new forms of strength.

Dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag> applies <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BANE">Bane</LSTag> to your target for three turns. This can be toggled at any time.

When you make a successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against a creature that is Large or smaller with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, immediately swap places with them. This can be toggled at any time.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, all enemies within [1] must succeed a Wisdom based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="COMPELLED_DUEL">Compelled</LSTag> to duel you for three turns.
After casting a Spell, you become <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistant</LSTag> to all damage for one turn.
When you cast a Spell, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to all damage until your next turn.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to all damage until the start of its next turn.
Upon dealing damage to a creature, you apply one <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CURSEOFHELLFIRE">Curse of Hellfire</LSTag> stack to your target.

Affected creature is taking [1] per turn. Whomever applied this status makes their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> when targeting the affected creature.

When an enemy fails an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, you may create a [1] cloud of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Darkness">Darkness</LSTag> as a free <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>. Upon doing so, you also gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DARKVISION">Darkvision</LSTag> for three turns.
When an enemy fails an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, create a [1] cloud of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Darkness">Darkness</LSTag>.
Dealing damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag> heals you for a value equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Charisma Modifier</LSTag>.

When you hit a creature with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_EldritchBlast">Eldritch Blast</LSTag>, you halve their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag>. This passive can be toggled at any time.
Affected creature's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is halved.
